newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African reserves data to be released on Friday.
newsitem.headline: S.African reserves data to be released on Friday.

text.p: South African gold and foreign exchange reserves data for September would be released on Friday October 4 at 1600 GMT, an official at the Reserve Bank said.
The data was originally scheduled for release on October 7.
According to a Reuters poll of 10 economists, gross reserves are expected to have dipped slightly to 10.06 billion rand in September from 10.08 billion in August.
The average forecast was drawn from a range of 9.8 billion rand to 10.5 billion rand.
